scope: Reconcile the prior 31-finding full audit against current HEAD and authoritative source, then list only currently proven spec mismatches, partial semantic implementations, source-blocked requirements, and actual release blockers. NOT_MAPPED/NOT_VERIFIED are not promoted to broken/missing without proof.

systems.spec: DOC-C §6.1 AgentAdapter requires execute/cancel/healthcheck plus canonical metadata; `call` is not part of the canonical interface.
systems.current: AgentAdapter extends SwarmAgent and assertAgentAdapter rejects adapters without `call`.
systems.usability: Internal adapters work, but a spec-exact external/future adapter implementing only the canonical surface is not registrable.

systems.spec: DOC-C §5.8 and incident law require lower-priority failures to be recorded as secondary incidents / secondary incident links.
systems.current: Run-bound FreezeIncident paths preserve lower-priority error codes in `secondaryErrorCodes[]` on the primary record instead of creating separate linked secondary incident records.
systems.usability: Priority ordering is usable; source-level linked secondary-incident forensic model is not fully implemented.

systems.spec: DOC-C §13.2: failed job is NOT auto retried unless explicitly configured and non-deterministic risk = none.
systems.current: BullMQ attempts=1, but the durable reconciler repeatedly selects FAILED rows and redispatches them every reconciliation cycle without a safe-retry allowlist or bounded cap.
systems.usability: FAILED durable dispatch behavior is not spec-safe for persistent failures; release-blocking until retry authority/classification is closed.

systems.spec: Authoritative source defines T0=Unknown, T1=Heuristic, T2=Empirical, T3=Formally Verified, T4=Immutable Law.
systems.current: l10_cognition maps T0 to 1.00 strongest and T4 to 0.25 weakest and tests assert T0>T1>T2>T3>T4.
systems.usability: CTS cannot be certified against the source. Numeric threshold values also remain authority-frozen; do not invent replacements.

systems.spec: L600 ICL requires semantic parsing/intent graph/constraint extraction, ambiguity_score, and WAIT_FOR_DATA_CLARITY when score exceeds threshold.
systems.current: Current canonical ICL/L1o path does not expose `ambiguity_score` or `WAIT_FOR_DATA_CLARITY`; authoritative threshold/scoring algorithm is itself unspecified.
systems.usability: Not usable as final REQ-L1O-002 compliance; implementation path must remain frozen until threshold/scoring authority is supplied.

systems.spec: L600 MPG calls for breadth-first coverage, depth-first precision and heuristic bias; EPE entropy is tied to ambiguity/missing constraints/probabilistic inference with soft-pruning behavior.
systems.current: Current path generation is deterministic DFS root→leaf; entropy proxy is distinct-token-count/path-length and pruning is based on that proxy rather than the source entropy dimensions.
systems.usability: DAG path enumeration works, but it is not a complete source-semantic MPG/EPE implementation.

systems.spec: IRL output must be structured truth candidates containing state, confidence and uncertainty; raw input must not enter reasoning.
systems.current: Canonical parser/ICL normalize input but do not expose the required confidence+uncertainty IRL output contract.
systems.usability: Cannot claim final-architecture IRL compliance.

systems.spec: IRL includes a canonical Confidence Estimator.
systems.current: Robotics sensor-fusion computes confidence, but is domain-specific and does not provide the full canonical IRL uncertainty contract.
systems.usability: Candidate implementation only; not a canonical generic IRL component.

systems.spec: IRL includes a canonical Data Normalizer.
systems.current: Text ICL and robotics sensor fusion contain normalization behavior, but no single final-architecture Data Normalizer binding exists.
systems.usability: Candidate/partial only.

systems.spec: IRL includes a canonical Noise Filter.
systems.current: ICL textual cleanup and robotics smoothing exist but are not bound as the canonical generic IRL Noise Filter.
systems.usability: Candidate/partial only.

systems.spec: IRL includes a generic Sensor Interface.
systems.current: RawSensorReading/SensorReading exist only in the robotics sensor-fusion candidate mapping.
systems.usability: Not established as canonical generic IRL input boundary.

systems.spec: CIRL output is `{intent, constraints, risk_level}`.
systems.current: Mapped ICL/law-enforcer derive intent/constraints but no canonical `risk_level` output contract is present.
systems.usability: Cannot claim final CIRL compliance.

systems.spec: CLE converts intent into explicit Safety Law, Logical Law, Resource Law and Temporal Law.
systems.current: LawEnforcer applies invariants and proofs but does not expose those four canonical law types as CLE outputs.
systems.usability: Partial law enforcement exists; final CLE contract is incomplete.

systems.spec: CLE Logical Law is an explicit canonical law type.
systems.current: Logical invariant enforcement exists but no canonical Logical Law object/type is established.
systems.usability: Partial only.

systems.spec: CLE Resource Law is an explicit canonical law type.
systems.current: Resource controls exist in game/WebGPU and Lo3 cage paths but are not bound as canonical CLE Resource Law.
systems.usability: Candidate/partial only.

systems.spec: CLE Safety Law is an explicit canonical law type.
systems.current: Robotics safety implementations exist, but mapping is domain-specific and not a proven canonical CLE Safety Law binding.
systems.usability: Candidate/partial only.

systems.spec: CLE Temporal Law is an explicit canonical law type.
systems.current: Temporal behavior exists in sandbox runtime but no canonical CLE Temporal Law binding is established.
systems.usability: Candidate/partial only.

systems.spec: DSL combines L1o+Lo3 into an action set such as `[{action, score}, ...]`.
systems.current: DecisionSynthesizer returns fused decision metadata rather than a scored action-set contract.
systems.usability: Current DSL cannot be treated as final source-semantic DSL.

systems.spec: Risk = Impact × Probability × Uncertainty and risk above threshold must block action.
systems.current: Risk formula exists, but complete execution-boundary proof that threshold violation always blocks action is not established.
systems.usability: Risk evaluator exists; hard-block final contract is not certified.

systems.spec: ECL includes Fast Path, Safe Path and Timeout fallback.
systems.current: ExecutionGate exists but current source contains none of those three required execution modes/fallbacks.
systems.usability: Not a complete final-architecture ECL.

systems.spec: L1o/Lo3/Lo2 are distinct finalized intelligence roles connected into the larger final architecture.
systems.current: Individual implementations exist, but no single canonical integration binding proves the complete Trinity contract.
systems.usability: Components are usable individually in covered paths; final integrated contract is not certified.

systems.spec: Minimum coverage: core/law/judge 90%, API 85%; critical suites must pass.
systems.current: At exact current head, API coverage straddles/falls below 85 on lines/statements/branches and JUDGE branch coverage is 88.37%; coverage_check exits 1.
systems.usability: Production/release authorization is blocked even though 95 test files / 715 tests, DOC-C static gate and web build pass.
